facts.text: The user wants content and recipe ideas for a website targeting English-preferring Hispanic women for the month of May.
The user wants the May content ideas to help the target express and share a multifaceted cultural identity through food.
The user wants the content ideas to consider different countries of origin including Mexico, Puerto Rico, the Dominican Republic, Venezuela, Peru, Chile, and others.
The user wants the content ideas to fuse different Latino cultures with other Latino and non-Latino cultures.
The user wants the content ideas to include time savings tips and ideas, hacks.
The user asked what the main events that take place in May are.
The user asked what food Cesar Chavez is known for.
The user wants 20 unexpected and outlandish American-Mexican recipe ideas for Cinco de Mayo.
The user wants 20 healthy and sustainable recipes that Cesar Chavez would approve of.
The user wants the Cesar Chavez-approved recipes to include ingredients produced by Mexican farmworkers in the US.
